# Manual release maintenance

The two release workflows are independent:

- **Bump version** takes one required `patch` (default), `minor`, or `major`
  choice. Select a branch using GitHub's built-in ref selector. It creates one
  source-only Actions-bot child commit on that exact branch, with a co-author
  trailer. It does not build, tag, release, or dispatch another workflow.
- **Build** has no custom inputs. Select the desired ref using GitHub's built-in
  selector. Every job checks out the same immutable `github.sha`; the version,
  tag target, release target, and filenames come from that selected source.
  There is no default-branch-only restriction.

The coordinated version authority is `Input Scope.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj`:
`MARKETING_VERSION` and `CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION` in the six original
Development/Deployment/Default target and project configurations must agree.
The source `Info.plist` short version and copied English localization must also
agree. The optional plist build key remains absent unless deliberately added.
Known version references are resolved and preserved. Bump changes only original
version token spans, preserving encodings, line endings, modes, and unrelated
content. Prebuilt bundle metadata is not authority.

The superseding coordinated Bump header and commit
`9ef61042dd365aa0bc8b51947ad4b4e514da97a3` establish this policy; the old body
incorrectly updated only marketing versions. The migration keeps **2.0.3** and
only aligns six stale source build assignments and source English display
versions. Destination/prebuilt metadata remains unchanged. **`v2.0.3` already
exists: run Bump separately before attempting a new Build.**

## Build and publication safety

Windows remains Release/x64 with v143/SDK 10.0 and the original CMD MSBuild
invocation. Its exact project OutDir is resolved case-insensitively without
recursive first-match discovery. Only the plugin executable and `Objs/Release`
intermediates are cleaned; unrelated bundle resources and siblings are retained.
The one uploaded Windows executable is merged and byte-rechecked at publication.
Inherited, workflow-scoped `core.autocrlf=false` is set before checkout. Windows
worktree executable-bit differences are tolerated only for regular files whose
raw Git blobs match; index modes and reparse/symlink checks remain strict.

macOS remains the Input Scope target, **Default**, universal arm64/x86_64, deployment
override 11.0, with its original frameworks, resources, and test package root.
The existing custom shell phase is Deployment-only and stays unchanged; it is
inactive under Default. Native cleanup is selective and all targets are
prevalidated before deleting anything. Fresh unsigned metadata/resources and
architectures are checked before signing. Signing, strict verification, both
notary exit codes and `Accepted` JSON responses, and DMG stapling are mandatory.
No 4D runtime execution or new dependency build is introduced.

Before native work, authentication and complete tag/release absence are checked.
After signing/notarization/stapling, all packaged generated leaves must still be
nonempty regular nonsymlink files. Built plist/localization, copied resources,
Windows artifact equality, immutable source/index bytes, hidden index flags,
and exact permitted generated dirt are revalidated. Generated bytes are retained,
not reset to fake a clean checkout. Only exact XCBuildData database/WAL/SHM
names and 32-hex `.xcbuilddata` descendants are permitted there.
Both `git ls-files -v` and `-f` are checked: an fsmonitor-valid index entry can
look ordinary to `-v` while hiding behind a lowercase `-f` marker.

Publication uses a repository-wide cross-ref concurrency group without
cancellation (this does not promise FIFO ordering). Authenticated release scans
include drafts and continue through an empty page. API and Git tag absence are
both mandatory; network/auth/schema/JSON failures stop publication. It then uses
separate create-only POSTs for the tag at the selected SHA and a new public
release, followed by uploads only to that newly returned release ID. Original
assets remain `Input Scope-X.Y.Z.zip` and `Input Scope-X.Y.Z.dmg`, with empty release notes
and no generated notes.

**Failure recovery is manual.** A race, ambiguous response, or failed upload
retains every possibly created tag, release, and asset. Inspect the reported
state before deciding what to do. There is no automatic retry, overwrite,
reuse, update, deletion, rollback, or clobber.

## Offline regression suite

Run `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` and
`actionlint .github/workflows/*.yml`. Python needs PyYAML; the PowerShell tests
require `pwsh` and fail rather than skip if it is unavailable.

Tests use local bare Git repositories, fake GitHub APIs, and closed-PATH native
and credential doubles. They exercise the actual helpers and extracted workflow
Bash/PowerShell without invoking native toolchains, signing/notary services,
secrets, or 4D. CMD is compared verbatim with the immutable intake workflow, not
translated into an invented adapter. Offline results do not prove hosted native
toolchain or service behavior.
